decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's mental-health support portfolio that gained home-page prominence by 2024, outpatient sociotherapy looks strategically promising and still worth carrying as a low-risk option.

The senior-living counseling service stayed prominently featured across both years and fits the firm's core eldercare capabilities, so management would likely retain it as a strong channel into related services.

The sheltered-workshop retail shop became more prominent in 2024 and builds on existing workshop activities, so despite some retail uncertainty its social and operational fit supports keeping it on the market.

The meal delivery service is still new and not yet highly prominent, but because it is close to the firm's senior-care offer and the firm is expanding, management would likely keep this option open until demand becomes clearer.
